```{exercise}
Find all sigma algebras for $\Omega = \{0, 1, 2\}$.

```

::: fold
```{solution, echo = togs}


- $A = \{\emptyset, \Omega\}$
- $A = 2^{\Omega}$
- $A = \{\emptyset, \{0\}, \{1,2\}, \Omega\}$
- $A = \{\emptyset, \{1\}, \{0,2\}, \Omega\}$
- $A = \{\emptyset, \{2\}, \{0,1\}, \Omega\}$

```
:::
